data_footnotes:
Prevalence rate: Proportion of persons living in Germany aged 16 and over who have been victimised once or more in a given period.
• Prevalence rate for physical violence: Due to methodological changes, the results from 2020 onwards are only comparable with previous years to a limited extend.
• Prevalence rate for psychological violence and for sexual violence: Data is only available from 2020.
• Psychological violence: This includes threats of violence online, threats of violence offline and personal insults online.
• Sexual violence: This includes display of genitals (against one's will), physical sexual harassment, and sexual abuse or rape.
